description: Bring a file from this computer into the project, like the app's upload. Pictures (PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/SVG): as media, character or object (joins a shot's cast or replaces a member's picture), or background. Videos (MP4/MOV/WebM): as media, video-background or video-front in a shot. Sounds (MP3/WAV/M4A...): as sound (sound Media, and on the timeline at `at` if given), music, or voice. Default: media for pictures and videos, sound for sounds. The file is copied into Dinoctor; the original isn't changed. One undo step. For pictures made before with Higgsfield, use put_picture.

as.description: How it goes into the project (see the description).

at.description: For as: sound, seconds into the film to place it on a free sound line.

name.description: A short name for it in the project.

path.description: Full path of the file on this computer.

replace.description: A cast member id in that shot whose picture this replaces.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

sound_kind.description: For as: sound, what it is (guessed from the name and length otherwise).

trim.description: For a character/object picture: cut its empty see-through edges (default true).

name: upload
